name: Business Central Implementation
description: Implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for finance, sales, purchasing and inventory.
problems_solved: Outdated or fragmented accounting software; manual work between Excel and separate systems
outcome: One integrated ERP system for finance and operations

name: Business Central Upgrade from NAV
description: Moving from Dynamics NAV or an older on-premises version to Business Central in the cloud.
problems_solved: Unsupported legacy NAV; costly customisations; no remote access
outcome: Up-to-date cloud ERP with lower maintenance cost

name: Business Central Support and Development
description: Ongoing user support, small developments and regular system health checks for Business Central.
problems_solved: No in-house ERP expertise; slow response to user issues
outcome: Stable system and fast help when needed

name: Finance & Operations Implementation
description: Implementation of Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management for complex, international businesses.
problems_solved: Several legal entities and countries; complex production or logistics; system limits reached
outcome: Scalable ERP for group-level finance and supply chain

name: Finance & Operations Optimisation
description: Review and improvement of an existing Dynamics 365 F&O solution: processes, performance and user adoption.
problems_solved: Users avoid the system; slow processes; unused functionality
outcome: Better return on the existing ERP investment

name: ERP Selection Advisory
description: Independent help with mapping requirements and choosing the right ERP platform and partner.
problems_solved: Unsure which ERP fits; no internal project experience
outcome: Clear requirements and a justified system choice

name: Business Process Analysis
description: Mapping current processes and designing improved target processes before a system change.
problems_solved: Processes depend on people, not systems; unclear responsibilities
outcome: Documented target processes and quick wins

name: ERP Project Management
description: Experienced project manager on the client side to lead an ERP or data project.
problems_solved: No internal capacity to lead a large IT project; budget and schedule risk
outcome: Project delivered on time and within budget

name: Power BI Reporting
description: Design and build of management and financial reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.
problems_solved: Reports are built manually in Excel; numbers differ between departments
outcome: Automated, consistent reports available to managers

name: Data Platform with Microsoft Fabric
description: Building a central data platform that combines data from ERP, CRM and other sources.
problems_solved: Data scattered across systems; no single source of truth
outcome: One trusted data foundation for reporting and AI

name: Budgeting and Forecasting Solution
description: Digital budgeting, forecasting and scenario planning connected to actual ERP data.
problems_solved: Budgeting in large Excel files; slow forecast updates
outcome: Faster planning cycle and reliable forecasts

name: AI Readiness Assessment
description: Workshop-based assessment of where AI can create value and what data and governance are needed first.
problems_solved: Interest in AI but no clear starting point; data quality concerns
outcome: Prioritised AI use cases and a practical roadmap

name: Microsoft Copilot Adoption
description: Introducing Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 Copilot with training, guidelines and pilot use cases.
problems_solved: Licences bought but little use; unclear rules for using AI
outcome: Employees use Copilot safely in daily work

name: AI Agents for Business Processes
description: Designing and building AI agents that automate repetitive tasks such as invoice handling or customer queries.
problems_solved: Repetitive manual work; slow response times
outcome: Less routine work and faster processing

name: Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Insights
description: Implementation of Dynamics 365 Sales and marketing automation for managing leads, customers and campaigns.
problems_solved: Customer data in spreadsheets; no overview of the sales pipeline
outcome: One view of customers and a measurable sales process

name: Managed IT Services
description: Day-to-day management of workstations, Microsoft 365, networks and user support.
problems_solved: No in-house IT team; IT issues interrupt the business
outcome: Reliable IT with predictable monthly cost

name: Cybersecurity Assessment
description: Review of the company's security level, risks and compliance (e.g. NIS2) with a prioritised action plan.
problems_solved: Unclear IT security level; new regulatory requirements
outcome: Known risks and a clear improvement plan

name: Security Monitoring (SOC)
description: Continuous monitoring of systems and quick response to security incidents.
problems_solved: No one watches for attacks outside office hours
